themes.name: 打印系统与控制
themes.object: 打印系统、打印控制设备和程序
themes.problem: 提供易于设置任意打印目的地的打印系统、打印控制设备和打印控制程序，以及缩短打印设备处理时间的方法。
themes.means: 通过打印服务器接收打印数据并传输给打印机；使用变量作业文件和数据库查询光标管理来生成和传输可变数据；在打印前获取打印参数以确保与原始打印一致。
themes.effect: 实现用户可以轻松设置任意打印目的地；缩短打印设备从接收数据到完成打印的时间；保证打印参数一致性。

evidence.quote: To provide a printing system, a printing control device, and a printing control program for easily printing print data with an arbitrary printout destination set thereto by mutual cooperation between printing control devices, from a desired printer on a communication network.

To provide a print control device and a print control system capable of shortening a processing time required by a print device from the start of receiving data required for printout to the completion of printing based on the data as compared to the case that the print device performs print processing after receiving the data required for the printout which is generated by a device at a requesting side based on the data received from a database.

To provide a document management device, a document management system and a document management program for which printing is performed with the same print parameter as that applied when a form is printed, even when a print source document is acquired from the page ID of a scanned form and printed.

themes.name: 无法确定
themes.object: 打印系统、打印机和程序
themes.problem: 在通过网络连接的打印系统中提高安全性。
themes.means: 客户端PC生成用于控制打印操作的控制程序，并将其与预生成的打印内容关联后输出为打印数据；打印机分离打印数据中的控制程序和打印内容并根据控制程序进行打印操作。
themes.effect: 允许客户端自由设定安全机制，从而提高系统的安全性。

evidence.quote: To make the degree of security high in a printing system in which a print data generating device and a printer are connected through a network.

A client PC 10 for generating print data generates a control program for controlling a printing operation in the printer 40, associates the generated control program with pregenerated print contents and outputs the control program associated with the pregenerated print contents as print data.
Since the client PC 10 side can freely set a security mechanism by thinking out a control program, the degree of security can be made higher than that of a simple authentication number.

analysis.heterogeneity: 该聚类包含多种技术主题，包括打印系统与控制、打印安全机制以及图像处理等，表明其异质性较高。
analysis.limitations: 部分专利文本仅提供标题和摘要，缺乏详细的技术实现细节；部分技术特征存在共现但不等于相同技术。
